# Merkava Flagship Revelation — Phase Three Final Plan

The Awtsmoos is not improved by ornament, yet every finite vessel may reveal more truth through order;
Awtsmoos.com should make the flagship's code read like architecture and its battlefield feel like one intentional border.

## Thirty final refinements

1. Keep the dirty `index.html` untouched.
2. Use `#gameShell` as the single Merkava CSS boundary.
3. Make `#gameShell` fixed/inset instead of relying on global body sizing.
4. Define all palette, radius, motion, and z-layer custom properties on `#gameShell`.
5. Keep canvas styles scoped to `#gameShell > #gameCanvas`.
6. Prefix every HUD selector with `#gameShell`.
7. Prefix every mode/boss/feedback/commerce selector with `#gameShell`.
8. Prefix every overlay/panel selector with `#gameShell`.
9. Replace overlay `z-index:10` with `--merkava-layer-overlay`.
10. Replace HUD `4`, labels `3`, notification `12`, fatal `30` with named layers.
11. Give notification motion explicit opacity/transform properties rather than `transition: 180ms ease`.
12. Keep animation transforms off touch hover by scoping hover media.
13. Give all buttons active depression and focus-visible ring.
14. Give Commander Sigil wallet link the same hover/active/focus contract.
15. Normalize form control sizing and focus states locally.
16. Preserve internal panel overflow but cap panel inline/block dimensions to viewport-safe logical units.
17. Preserve short-height HUD compression without shrinking action hit targets.
18. Add local reduced-motion behavior only inside `#gameShell`.
19. Create `YesodInputPort` as an abstract lifecycle/API base.
20. Create `MerkavaInputActions` as the explicit adapter from mutable state + ability/pause commands to input API.
21. Rewrite `InputController extends YesodInputPort` with injected keyboard target and disconnectable bound handlers.
22. Add JSDoc to every constructor and public/private method in rewritten input files.
23. Create `OhrRuntimeJournal` to own runtime error capture with connect/disconnect and immutable snapshots.
24. Create `OptionalCommerceGateway` to own best-effort dynamic commerce boot.
25. Create `KesserMerkavaBootstrap` to assemble app, diagnostics, journal, and optional commerce while preserving legacy globals.
26. Rewrite `main.js` to only instantiate and awaken the bootstrap.
27. Rewrite `MerkavaApp` with an optional explicit dependency vessel while keeping zero-argument compatibility.
28. Add JSDoc to every rewritten `MerkavaApp` method and use domain-specific local names at new composition seams.
29. Target-compile `src/main.js` through CompactJS after all JS changes; the protected HTML already requests compact mode.
30. Run unit, syntax, renderer, style, browser, line-count, long-line, and git-diff gates; then reread every touched file and write a post-implementation delta.

## Baseline-before-write gate

Run `npm run verify` in `games/Merkava` before the first production rewrite. If it already fails, record the exact baseline. The input constructor mismatch should be tested directly rather than hidden by unrelated suites.

## Runtime acceptance after writing

Desktop, 390×844, 320×568, and short-height phone where practical:
- zero document side overflow;
- start/pause/choice/game-over panels fully contained;
- HUD readable and not crossing player-shell controls;
- every visible interactive game control >=44px on phone;
- no raw element leaves `#gameShell` styling scope;
- no hardcoded Merkava z-index remains outside named tokens;
- keyboard, tap/drag lane, ability, and pause all work;
- runtime errors empty;
- Campaign/Endless diagnostics compatibility preserved.
